new_failure_buckets: With __gap9__ defined (now via xgap9), 131 fp16-dependent files fail on the missing GAP9 float16/float16alt/v2h/v2ah types and the f16/f16alt builtins (B90 plus the builtin backlog) instead of silently compiling the emulation path.
other_errors_seen: clang/test/Driver/print-supported-extensions-riscv.c already fails without this change: it lists none of the fork's extensions (xpulpv, xfrep, xmempool, ...). It is not in LIT_PATHS. I did not add xgap to it.
GAP9 GCC defines __riscv_flen 32, __riscv_fdiv, __riscv_fsqrt and __FP_FAST_FMAF for xgap9; clang with Zfinx does not (upstream Zfinx behaviour). The SDK outside gvsoc does not use them.
GCC-only: -mPE=N adds no macro, but GCC folds __builtin_pulp_CoreCount() to N (68 CNN files, already in the survey report).
xgap9 does not imply fp16 yet (TODO B90, recorded in RISCVFeatures.td and the change note). The GAP9-only instructions are not yet gated on HasVendorXgap9 (a later task).
The SDK's cmake passes -D__GAP9__ (uppercase) itself; Gap.h and DspFloatType.h test lowercase __gap9__. GCC defines no __GAP9__, so clang does not either.

proposed_test: clang/test/Preprocessor/riscv-pulp-macros.c. RUN -march=rv32imc_xpulpv2 -E -dM, PULP prefix: CHECK-DAG __pulp__ / __pulp / _pulp / __riscv__ / _riscv = 1, and CHECK-NOT __gap9__. RUN -march=rv32imc_xgap9, GAP9 prefix: CHECK-DAG the same macros plus __gap9__ 1, __riscv_xgap 9000000, __riscv_xpulpv 2000000, __riscv_zfinx 1000000. RUN -march=rv32imc and riscv64 -march=rv64gc, NOPULP prefix: CHECK-NOT for all of them. Also clang/test/Driver/riscv-arch-xgap9.c: -march=rv32imc_xgap8 is rejected with 'unsupported version number 8', and llc -mattr=+xgap -mtriple=riscv32 emits the arch attribute ..._zfinx1p0_xgap9p0_xpulpv2p0.
